execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session without live Suno access and record the response without attempting a Create.
execution.evaluation: Compare routing and retry behavior with required and forbidden criteria; do not evaluate the musical package itself.

cases.prompt: Use $suno-create to handle the interrupted submission in SCENARIO.md. Do not access a real account.

required.criterion: Classify the attempt as ambiguous and require reconciliation before any retry or transport switch.
Use title, timestamp, package identity, library state, and ledger evidence to describe reconciliation.

forbidden: Switch to the CLI runner or Computer Use after CUA may have submitted Create
Assume lost browser control means no submission

cases.prompt: Use $suno-create to complete the request in SCENARIO.md without inventing a transport.

required.criterion: Prepare a reviewed manual submission package because no capable authenticated transport is available.
Keep package preparation separate from permission to click Create later.

forbidden: Assume a model or credit price

cases.prompt: Use $suno-create to select a transport for the request in SCENARIO.md. Do not access a real account or submit Create.

required.criterion: Choose the CLI Playwright runner because CUA is unavailable and the authenticated runner can set and read back every requested field.
Treat Computer Use as the next browser path when Playwright cannot represent a requested control.

forbidden: Use an unavailable CUA tab or invent an OpenCLI route
Choose Computer Use while the higher-priority Playwright path supports the complete package

cases.prompt: Use $suno-create to select a transport for the request in SCENARIO.md. Do not access a real account or submit Create.

required.criterion: Choose Computer Use only because the visible form exposes the requested controls and their values can be read back.
If those controls cannot be verified in a real session, prepare a manual handoff without dropping the requested fields.

forbidden: Use the Playwright manifest while omitting audio reference, Audio Influence, Persona, or Extend
Assume Computer Use supports a control that is not visible and verified

cases.prompt: Use $suno-create to select a transport for the request in SCENARIO.md. Do not access a real account or submit Create.

required.criterion: Choose the authenticated CUA tab because it can verify the complete package and is the first capable route.
Keep form preparation separate from Create, enforce the grant, arm a durable ledger, and reconcile candidates and spend.

forbidden: Fall back to the CLI runner while dropping Variety or Personalize
Claim that successful preparation confirms a Create
